title: Florida v. J.L. (2000)
key_points: Holding: An anonymous tip that a person at a location has a gun, with nothing showing the tipster's reliability or knowledge, does not justify a stop and frisk.
officer_notes: Scenario: An unknown caller says a young man in a plaid shirt at a bus stop has a gun. You see him, but nothing he does is suspicious.
Takeaway: Corroborate an anonymous tip with your own observations before acting.
